description: Golden questions for retrieval, routing, and escalation evaluation. Each question is a realistic student query grounded in terms actually present in the curated corpus (knowledge/curated/). expected_source_ids lists the source(s) the retrieval should surface (Day 2). expected_journey and expected_escalation were added in Day 3 to evaluate deterministic journey routing and policy-driven escalation over the same questions; no existing field was changed.

questions.question: Who do I contact for wellness and counselling support?
questions.grounding: Source title is 'Wellness and Counselling'; page lists named counsellors and contact emails.

questions.question: I'm feeling anxious, what resources does NBCC have?
questions.grounding: 'Anxiety' is explicitly listed under 'We Can help you with' on the wellness page.

questions.question: What is myWellness and how do I get 24/7 mental health support?
questions.grounding: 'myWellness' and '24/7 Virtual Support' are named on the wellness page.

questions.question: Is there support for sexual violence or assault on campus?
questions.grounding: Page names the Campus Sexual Assault Support Advocate (CSASA) and sexual violence resources.
questions.escalation_note: Journey routing uses the top-1 retrieval result, which for this question is NBCC-SS-002 (academic_support) due to the known D2-FU-01 footer-boilerplate near-miss (score 45 vs. 44; NBCC-SS-005 still ranks #2). expected_journey reflects that actual, currently-correct behavior rather than the intended domain, so this test does not silently mask the limitation. The escalation layer is independent of retrieval ranking: it matches 'assault'/'violence' directly against ESCALATION_POLICY.md trigger 1 (Sensitive Personal Information) and escalates regardless of which source ranked first. This is the safety property that matters most for this question, and is why D2-FU-01 remains a backlog item rather than a blocker: the current system does not silently answer a safety-sensitive question with the wrong journey's informational content — it escalates to human support either way.

questions.question: How can a Student Success Coach help me transition to college life?
questions.grounding: 'Ease Your Transition' is a named section on the Student Success Coaching page.

questions.question: What is the Nitap Peer Mentor Program?
questions.grounding: 'Nitap (Peer) Mentor Program' is explicitly named on the Student Success Coaching page.

questions.question: Are there recordings of orientation sessions for new students?
questions.grounding: 'Orientation for New Students (Recordings)' is a named section on the Student Success Coaching page.

questions.question: What is NBCC's Early Alert and PASS program?
questions.grounding: 'Early Alert Program & PASS' is explicitly named on the general Student Services page.

questions.question: What programs and services are available to NBCC students overall?
questions.grounding: General overview page introducing the range of Student Services.

questions.question: What is the NBCC Student Learning Experience Charter?
questions.grounding: 'NBCC Student Learning Experience Charter' is explicitly named on the general Student Services page.
